Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the MS analysis section is a discovery-based affinity purification (AP-MS) comparing a TAP-tagged Scc1 strain against an untagged control strain to identify interactors. While the rest of the paper focuses on genetic deletions (isw1Δ, ioc3Δ, etc.) and their effects on cohesin distribution, these were analyzed via ChIP-seq and CoIP/Western Blot, not the primary MS screen described in the PRIDE metadata and the 'Scc1-TAP purification and MS analysis' section.
